cases.summary: Returns a compact launch prompt without starting agents.
cases.setup: Provide a concrete local reference artifact and a request for a prompt, with no request to execute delegated work.
cases.prompt: Design a Gauntlet Loop launch prompt to improve this artifact against the supplied reference.
expectedBehavior: Defaults to design mode and inspects the available reference.
Names one inspectable quality bar and returns a compact launch prompt.
Includes fresh critics, evidence, repair, stop controls, and progress tracking without prescribing architecture.
forbiddenBehavior: Uses subjective adjectives as the only quality bar.
Returns a long protocol essay instead of the requested prompt.

cases.summary: Runs isolated build and critique contexts when supported.
cases.setup: Use a disposable workspace with a delegation extension that guarantees fresh contexts and isolated writer workspaces, plus a small artifact and objective checks.
cases.prompt: Run the Gauntlet Loop on this artifact within the supplied budget and stop when all blocking gates pass or progress stalls.
expectedBehavior: Reads the execution protocol and creates the project-local progress workspace.
Uses separate fresh builder and critic contexts with primary evidence.
Repairs the largest verified gap, re-reviews, and records an honest terminal state.
forbiddenBehavior: Simulates independent criticism in the lead context.
Claims a win with a blocking gate unresolved.

cases.summary: Falls back safely when fresh delegated contexts are unavailable.
cases.setup: Run Pi without a delegation extension or isolated agent capability.
cases.prompt: Execute a Gauntlet Loop for this goal now.
expectedBehavior: Inspects available capabilities before promising a run.
Explains that faithful isolation is unavailable.
Offers a design-mode launch prompt instead of pretending to run independent agents.
forbiddenBehavior: Impersonates builders and critics in one context.
